entry.title: 研究資料寄存所功能更新：Data Package 支援上線

link.title: 研究資料寄存所功能更新：Data Package 支援上線

entry.content:
Data Package（資料封裝包）是一種描述資料集與其所包含資料的標準，由開放知識基金會設計。一個 Data Package 壓縮檔，包含以 JSON Schema 描述資料集後設資料的 datapackage.json 描述檔，以及一或多個資料檔案。

研究資料寄存所 (depositar) 已於日前（v6.8.0 版本）新增 Data Package 支援，主要功能如下1：

可下載資料集為 Data Package

您可點選資料集頁面右上角「下載 Data Package」按鈕，取得最新版本之 Data Package 壓縮檔2：

可匯入 Data Package 為資料集

您可上傳來自其他網站的 Data Package（如 GBIF 自動相機資料 與 DataHub Core Data），並寄存為 depositar 資料集：

能自動產製 Data Package

當您建立與編輯資料集，depositar 將自動產製 Data Package2。

備註

  1. 詳細功能說明，請參考操作手冊。 ↩

  2. 考量系統穩定性，Data Package 功能現僅提供（上傳至 depositar 之）資源大小合計小於或等於 50 MB 的資料集。 ↩ ↩2

entry.title: 運用大型語言模型補綴 QGIS 繁體中文介面，成果已於研究資料寄存所釋出

link.title: 運用大型語言模型補綴 QGIS 繁體中文介面，成果已於研究資料寄存所釋出

entry.content:
QGIS 為著名的桌面 GIS 軟體，因其開放原始碼、免費及豐富的外掛程式，深受社群喜愛。然而，由志工維護的 QGIS，卻長期面臨繁體中文語系介面品質不佳的問題。在功能持續擴充的同時，由於翻譯人力的缺乏，加上不諳簡繁中文差異的翻譯者之錯譯，使得介面中英夾雜、繁簡交織、功能名稱不一致等情形層出不窮。

本實驗室致力於推廣開放原始碼軟體，亦曾於過去數年安排 QGIS 暑期講習。我們深知不完備的在地化介面，對於軟體普及的障礙。為提升 QGIS 繁體中文介面翻譯品質，陳育霖同學於去年（2025 年）在本實驗室實習期間，使用大型語言模型 (LLM) 以及檢索增強生成 (RAG) 技術，設計出一套可於 Jupyter Book 網頁中執行之自動翻譯工具。實作細節可參考陳同學撰寫之技術說明。

延續其實習專題成果，陳同學日前已將補綴完成之繁體中文語系（已寄存於 depositar 專案）貢獻至 QGIS 官方翻譯專案，使翻譯完成率自原先的 70% 提升至 99%（QGIS 3.4x 版本），並克服特殊標記文字與 GIS 專業術語一致性等問題。此翻譯將包含於下一個 QGIS（3.40 LTR 與 3.44）增補更新之中。

經大型語言模型補綴後之 QGIS 繁體中文介面

entry.title: Year 2025 in Review
entry.content:
(Meadow nearby the Keelung River. Photo taken in November, 2025.)

We at the depositar lab wish you a joyful Lunar New Year. We take this occasion to summarize below our works from the previous year (2025-01 – 2025-12).

Hosted Projects and Datasets

  • There have been 3,257 datasets deposited and made public at the depositar, the research data repository we build and operate, by the end of Year 2025 (2025-12-31). The datasets have accumulated more than one million views.

  • More than 500 projects have been hosted at the depositar by 2025 (2025-12-31).

  • For more statistics and charts, please visit the depositar’s stats page.

System Upgrade and Enhancement

  • The system underlining the depositar (data.depositar.io) had been upgraded six times (from v6.7.2 to v6.7.7).

  • The depositar introduced a new interface based on Bootstrap 5.

  • In late 2025, we made a change to the depositar so that a dataset not belonging to any project can only be edited by its uploader and collaborators.

  • The depositar stats page has been released online.

  • The Research Data Management Hub (RDM Hub) has been rebuilt as a static site generated by Hugo and Sveltia CMS.

Writing on Research Data Management (RDM)

  • Ten new articles appeared on the RDM Hub website. Some of them were also published in Science and Technology Report 《科技報導》, appearing on the journal’s website on 2025-03-19, 2025-08-15, 2025-11-15, and 2025-12-15.

Seminar and Outreach

  • In February, we are invited by the Institute of Earth Sciences at the Academia Sinica to share experience about research data management during the Institute’s weekly Geotalk event.

  • In May, we gave a talk at the National Chengchi University Library on Bringing research data to life - Research Data Management x Open Science strategy.

  • In July, we joined the Research Data Alliance (RDA) & International Data Week 2025 Webinar to talk about our work in Taiwan.

  • In November, we joined RDA again during their Oceania and Asia Data Roundtable to share about our Data Management Plan localization project.

  • In December, we co-hosted an online workshop on Open Science Tools at the invitation of Professor Chuan-Kai Lin from National Sun Yat-sen University.

  • We held Research Data Management Remote Office Hour (研究資料管理線上諮詢) in December, 2025.

Presentation at International Conference

  • In April, we presented Recently Orphaned Newspapers: From Archived Webpages to Reusable Datasets and Research Outlooks at the Web Archiving Conference 2025 (WAC2025) in Oslo, Norway, in the Discovery & Access (News/Newspapers) session.

  • In June, we presented Automated Data Analytics: A Statistical Dashboard Built with GitLab CI/CD for a Data Repository Based on CKAN at the 20th International Conference on Open Repositories (OR2025) in Chicago, Illinois, USA.

  • In July, we presented a poster, Historical Vernacular Houses in the Hualien River Basin of Eastern Taiwan: A Spatial Humanities Investigation with Research Data Management Planning, at Digital Humanities 2025 (DH 2025) in Lisbon, Portugal.

  • In August, we delivered the aforementioned work, Recently Orphaned Newspapers, to audiences in Taiwan at COSCUP (Conference for Open Source Coders, Users and Promoters), the largest gathering of its kind in Asia, under the Traditional Chinese title 〈當代的孤兒報刊：網頁保存、研究資料、以及未來展望〉.

  • In September, we give a talk on Advancing Research Data Management in Southeast Asia: Gaps, Challenges, & Policy Recommendations at the PNC 2025 Annual Conference and Joint Meetings, in Hanoi, Vietnam.

  • In October, we delivered two presentations at the International Data Week 2025:

    • Building Sustainable Research Data Services in Taiwan: Experience from the depositar as part of the panel Research data stewardship in the Asia Pacific – What is happening now and how to move forward?
    • The Role of Data in AI for Science, presented in the AI for Science — CODATA Convened Session as well as in the Co-Designing AI Readiness: CODATA’s Call to the Global Data Community session.

Internship Students, Visiting scholars, and New Lab Member

  • A total of seven internship students were received in the Summer of 2025. We organized short courses for the interns on Linux, Git, RDM, Jupyter Book, QGIS, OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, among others. They also worked on short-term projects.

  • In addition, the lab continues to support several students with stipends working on projects related to RDM, digital preservation, and data policies.

  • Dr. Yoann Goudin (Université Lyon 3 – Jean Moulin) visited the lab in the summer working on a thematic research project funded by Academia Sinica on island soundscape.

  • Dr. James X. Morris continues to visit the depositar lab. He is a postdoctoral scholar at the Center for GIS, RCHSS, Academia Sinica.

  • Ting-Yu Chuang joined the lab in March as an assistant engineer then departed at the end of year for a position at TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company).

Serving Research Data Communities

  • We continue to work with Taiwan’s Long-term Social-Ecological Research Network in fostering good data management practices.

  • Hilary Shiue served in the RDM Terminology Working Group of CODATA during the 2025 review cycle.

  • Tyng-Ruey Chuang finished his third term in the Executive Committees of CODATA (Committee on DATA), International Science Cuncil.

  • Tyng-Ruey Chuang continues to serve in CODATA Taiwan and Taiwan Biodiversity Information Facility (TaiBIF) as national committee members.

  • Tyng-Ruey Chuang co-chairs Academia Sinica’s Generative AI Risk Study Committee in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

We wish you all a fruitful New Year! – Ally, Cheng-Jen, Hilary, Tyng-Ruey, and Winnie.

entry.title: 2025 年國際資料週紀要
entry.content:
2025 年國際資料週 (International Data Week 2025) 於十月中旬在澳洲布里斯本召開。研究資料寄存所參與了此次盛會。以下會議紀要由莊庭瑞撰寫。

國際資料週背景

國際資料週 (International Data Week, IDW) 於 2016 年首次在美國科羅拉多州丹佛市舉行，之後約兩年一次接續於波札那首都嘉柏隆里（2018 年）、南韓首爾（因 COVID-19 延至 2022 年舉行，為實體與線上會議混和模式）、以及奧地利的薩爾茲堡（2023 年）舉行。2025 年的國際資料週於十月 13 到 16 日在澳洲布里斯本召開。歷次的國際資料週聚集來自各地倡議科學資料開放使用的研究者和學生、研究資料管理的實務工作者、研究圖書館以及資料儲存庫館員、以及關心研究資料政策發展的諸多人士，在為期四天的盛會中分享工作近況並交換前景看法，協力推展科學資料的普世運用。

國際資料週的議程概由國際科學資料委員會 (Committee on Data, CODATA)、世界資料系統 (World Data System, WDS)、以及研究資料聯盟 (Research Data Alliance, RDA) 與當地籌辦單位共同規劃。其中 CODATA 與 WDS 為國際科學理事會 (International Science Council, ISC) 所屬獨立組織，RDA 為研究資料從事人員的團體。CODATA 與 WDS 都是由會員體所組成的獨立法人。CODATA 的會員體為國家科學資料委員會以及不同學科領域的國際學會，WDS 的會員體則是資料儲存庫的經營者。RDA 的經費來自澳洲、歐盟、美國和其他國家的科研資助機關、非營利基金會、以及研究機構等。

此次會議主題

今年的國際資料週（簡稱 IDW2025）的主題為「以資料推進改變：社群發展與研究進展」(Data for positive change: Empowering communities and advancing research)，當地籌辦單位是「澳洲研究資料共享組織」 (Australian Research Data Commons, ARDC)。ARDC 為引領澳洲研究資料基礎設施的新設機構，於 2018 年成立，合併自 Australian National Data Service (ANDS), National eResearch Collaboration Tools and Resources (Nectar) 以及 Research Data Services (RDS) 三個組織，目前成員規模約有六十人。大會開幕式由 ARDC 執行長 Rosie Hicks 開場並主持，介紹 Tony Haymet （澳洲首席科學家）以及 Margaret Sheil （昆世蘭科技大學校長，兼澳洲科學院科學政策秘書）致歡迎詞。大會設有 LinkedIn 頁面每日發布會議摘要。CODATA, WDS, RDA 和部份與會者、計畫團隊、研究組織等也使用 LinkedIn 報導各自的場次。眾人藉此可了解並回顧會議動態。

IDW2025 安排了四場大會演講，主題概為原住民族資料治理、AI 與可再現的科學、開放研究與國際連結、以及平等包容的全球資料社群。CODATA 跟 WDS 也分別組織了 AI 與科學、以及儲存庫永續經營的主題場次。在原住民族資料治理的大會主題演講中，來自台灣的林季平（中央研究院人文社會科學研究中心）、來自北極圈薩米 (Sámi) 族人 Niklas Labba（獨立研究者）、以及澳洲本地的 Marcia Langton（墨爾本大學）分享原住民族資料在蒐集管理、自主治理、商業文化等諸多面向的議題與各自的工作經驗。在 CODATA 組織的 AI for Science 場次中，Merce Crosas Navarro（巴塞隆納超級電腦中心）、Vanessa McBride (ISC)、Vyacheslav Tykhonov (CODATA)、Christine Kirkpatrick（聖地牙哥超級電腦中心）以及莊庭瑞（中央研究院資訊科學研究所）就 AI 時代的研究資料組織與治理，以及相應的科學發展議題，提出看法和建議。

來自亞太的研討議程

大會議程包括了 107 場次的討論以及 130 篇壁報。不計入澳洲，來自亞太地區的研究人員與研究設施管理者，在這次大會中組織了（至少）三場議程：

  • Research data stewardship in the Asia Pacific – What is happening now and how to move forward?
    • 莊庭瑞與薛絲尹（中央研究院資訊科學研究所）召集組織
  • Building an Open Data Collaborative Network in Asia-Oceania
    • 金尾政紀 Masaki Kanao（日本大學聯合利用機關法人資訊系統研究機構）召集組織
  • Libraries for Research Data
    • 吳淑妮 Su-Nee Goh（新加坡南洋理工大學圖書館）召集組織

其中，廖培珊（中央研究院人文社會科學研究中心）就中央研究院經營維持學術調查研究資料庫 (Survey Research Data Archive, SRDA) 的經驗進行分享。莊庭瑞與薛絲尹報告同由中央研究院營運的研究資料寄存所 (depositar) 的工作。在 Libraries for Research Data 場次，來自香港科技大學 (HKUST) 以及印尼國家研究與創新署 (BRIN) 的研究資料圖書館員的報告令人印象深刻。前者使用開放的書目索引 OpenAlex 探究來自 HKUST 的諸多論文中，其「資料可取得聲明」(Data Availability Statements) 的概要情形。後者調查分析從事研究資料管理的圖書館員的「面貌」 (persona)，這些館員是開放科學實務的重要推手，但其學科領域與專業背景多樣。

反思與報導

國際資料週的議程緊湊，經常高達十個場次同時進行，本文無法充份描述。在諸多場次中，第二天大會演講中 Agnes Kiragga（非洲人口健康研究中心）、Ana M. Arjona（美國西北大學）、Juliet Gerrard（紐西蘭奧克蘭大學）三位講者所分享的內容，著重社會經濟資料與政策制定面向，十分精彩。其中 Juliet Gerrard 曾擔任兩任紐西蘭總理的首席科學顧問，對於科學專業在政策建議的效用與時機，提出敏銳的觀察。她以「嚴謹、包容、透明、親和」(Rigour, Inclusivity, Transparency, Accessibility; RITA) 為原則，期許科學知識指引政策決定。她並用「科學共識」(scientific consensus) 與「價值共識」(values consensus) 的分歧與否，劃分四個象限，說明政策建議的難易情境。她將於近日出版這主題的專書。

根據 ARDC 的統計，這次國際資料週共有 807 位與會者（其中 103 位為線上參與），來自 75 個國家。台灣這次有七位與會。相較於其他經濟發達國家，台灣的參加人數不算多。研究資料基礎設施以及研究資料管理實務，是科學發展的基石，但在台灣還未能獲得應有的重視。若以兩年一次的國際資料週為借鏡，在科學資料與政策的國際發展與交流合作，還需要台灣科研資助機構的長期投入與關注。關於此次國際資料週的反思與報導，尚可參見以下研究組織的網站內容：

  • ARDC: https://ardc.edu.au/article/the-ardc-reflects-on-international-data-week-2025/
  • CODATA: https://codata.org/blog/category/idw2025/
  • RDA: https://www.rd-alliance.org/news-stories/
  • WDS: https://worlddatasystem.org/idw2025_recap/

下一屆的國際資料週，將於 2027 年九月 20 到 23 日在南非開普敦舉行。

2025 年國際資料週會場（照片來源：IDW2025）.

entry.title: Report on the 20th International Conference on Open Repositories (OR2025)

link.title: Report on the 20th International Conference on Open Repositories (OR2025)

entry.content:
The 20th International Conference on Open Repositories (OR2025) was held in the City of Chicago, Illinois, USA, from June 15th to 18th, 2025. In this brief report, Tyng-Ruey Chuang outlined a few sessions in the main conference program and the depositar lab’s participation.

The venue of Open Repositories 2025 (OR2025) was at the University of Chicago Lab School nearby the campus of the University of Chicago. The main conference was held on June 16-18 while workshops were given on the 15th. Three members of the depositar lab (Tyng-Ruey Chuang, Cheng-Jen Lee, and Li Fan Wang) attended OR2025. We are thankful to the Local Host Organizing Committee for their hospitality and for arranging our accommodation at the Campus North Residential Commons, a modern facility in the heart of the UChicago campus and within walking distance to the conference venue.

The conference started with a keynote from Heather Joseph, the Executive Director of SPARC, on The Role of Open Access to Knowledge in a Challenging Political Landscape. Our presentation, on Automated Data Analytics: A Statistical Dashboard Built with GitLab CI/CD for a Data Repository Based on CKAN, was given by Ms Li Fan Wang, who is a graduate student from the National Cheng Kung University supported in part by Academia Sinica, in the Developer Track Session 2. The presentation was well received; in the Q&A session the team answered several questions from the audience.

Presentations in OR2025 are all timely and interesting. In particular, I am attracted to a presentation from the Brazilian Institute for Information in Science and Technology on Recognizing Software as a Critical Component in Open Science: Advancing an Interoperable, Community-Driven Vision for Infrastructures which is aligned with our approach in reusing and extending open source software, such as CKAN, for research data infrastructures. We also learn about new development at Figshare, Archipelago Commons, Dataverse, Fedora, Dspace, and InvenioRDM in Session 1 of Repository Showdown. We are very happy to meet a researcher from the West And Central African Research and Education Network (WACREN) and to learn that, as is the case at the depositar, they also use ARK to issue persistent identifiers for datasets at BAOBAB, an Invenio-based research data repository provided by WACREN to their member institutions. The presentation from the Fedora Community on finding its future path by learning from the past and bringing others together is very inspiring.

Following the tradition of the Open Repositories conferences, the presentation materials from OR2025 can now be found in a collection at Zenodo. Previously we had presented at Open Repositories in 2015, and from 2021 to 2025. Open Repositories 2026 will be held online on June 8-11, 2026. We plan to continue our contribution to this important series of conferences on research data infrastructures.

Heather Joseph (SPARC) giving a keynote at Open Repositories 2025.

entry.title: 新版研究資料管理推進室網站正式上線

link.title: 新版研究資料管理推進室網站正式上線

entry.content:
在多年使用 Drupal 架站之後，我們終於完成了對研究資料管理推進室（Research Data Management Hub，中文縮寫：RDM 推進室）網站的全面更新，順利遷移到以 Hugo 和 Sveltia CMS 建置的全新靜態網站，並採用 Blowfish 主題。新版網站不只結構更清楚、效能更好，也更容易維護。

這次的改版主要由莊婷伃助理工程師貢獻，並在研究資料寄存所團隊提供許多的回饋與協助下完成。歡迎大家造訪全新的 RDM 推進室，並持續關注未來的消息與更新！

entry.title: 研究資料寄存所團隊參與 2025 年國際資料週 (IDW 2025)

link.title: 研究資料寄存所團隊參與 2025 年國際資料週 (IDW 2025)

entry.content:
2025 年國際資料週 (International Data Week 2025; IDW 2025) 十月十三到十六日在澳洲布里斯本舉行，研究資料寄存所團隊參與了這場盛會。

於此次會議，研究資料寄存所由薛絲尹跟莊庭瑞組織了一場議程：《亞太地區的研究資料管理現況與前景》(Research data stewardship in the Asia Pacific – What is happening now and how to move forward?)。該場次邀集來自日本、新加坡、台灣共四組研究團隊共同討論。於此場次，我們以研究資料寄存所 (depositar) 出發，分享在台灣建造可永續的研究資料服務的經驗 (Building Sustainable Research Data Services in Taiwan: Experience from the depositar).

在 CODATA 所召集的 AI for Science 場次，莊庭瑞跟聖地牙哥超級電腦中心的 Christine Kirkpatrick 以 The Role of Data In AI for Science 為題，進行一場簡報。

2025 年國際資料週的議程由 CODATA、World Data System、以及 Research Data Alliance 所安排組織。此次大會係由「澳洲研究資料共有資源」(Australian Research Data Commons; ARDC) 籌辦並贊助。為期四天的會議中計有四場大會演講、107 場議程、以及 130 篇海報發表。八百多位參與者來自 75 個國家。

國際資料週兩年舉辦一次，下一次會議將於 2027 年九月二十到二十三日在南非開普敦舉行。

Research Data Stewardship in the Asia Pacific 場次的講者。(Photo: Brian)
AI for Science — CODATA Convened Session 場次的講者。(Photo: International Data Week 2025)
